open_questions: If Titanium/Ambassador lapses during the Aeroplan status year, is the matched 25K kept until its own expiry?
Does matched 25K carry every benefit of earned 25K (for example Select Benefits)?
restrictions: Trial or temporary Marriott status does not qualify
Registration is reviewed; status is not guaranteed
Either program may end or change the offering without notice

retention.note: Official terms give a minimum 12-month validity and then program expiry rules, but do not say whether the status is withdrawn if the Marriott tier is lost first.

summary: Marriott Titanium or Ambassador Elite members can obtain Aeroplan 25K by registering through the Marriott Bonvoy / Aeroplan partnership site (account names must match; allow 7-10 business days).
